Get Track Comment Count

GET 
/tracks/:track_id/comment_count

Get the comment count for a track

Request​

Path Parameters

    track_id stringrequired

    A Track ID

Query Parameters

    user_id string

    The user ID of the user making the request

Responses​

  • 200
  • 400
  • 500

Success

  • application/json
  • Schema
  • Example (from schema)

Schema

    datainteger
{
  "data": 0
}

Bad request

Server error
